expectations.text: Classifies BOD as a Group I pollutant with a technical review criterion of 1.4x the limit (40% over)
Concludes 25% over does not meet the TRC
Explains the chronic criterion needs exceedance in 4 or more of 6 months and that 3 months does not meet it
Concludes the data does not meet the effluent SNC criteria
Caveats that reporting violations (e.g. late/missing DMRs) can independently cause SNC and that EPA/the state assigns SNC status
expectations.evidence: Late DMRs and regulator determination covered
